notes.title: v201 Bugs patched!
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for letting me know the achievements were bugged. The most recent patch should fix the achievements not working. If you have any more trouble please just let us know!

Thanks again for the help!

notes.title: Steam Achievements and Linux Support Added!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This build brings us Linux support and our most requested feature - Steam Achievements. There are 13 to unlock so start collecting!

As always feedback, bug reports, and commentary is always appreciated. Join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/VKDqfGrdWF]Discord[/url] and let us know what you think!


We've been hard at work on our next game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2165840/Ropu_Barastu_No_X/]Ropu Barastu No X[/url] for a while, too. Hopefully we'll see some of you there!
